declarations.docstring: The algebra endomorphism of a multivariable polynomial ring induced by left multiplication by a square matrix.
Left-multiplication algebra homomorphisms send a coordinate variable to the corresponding matrix-linear combination of coordinate variables.
The left-multiplication polynomial algebra homomorphism commutes under composition with an auxiliary algebra homomorphism.
The left-multiplication polynomial algebra homomorphism maps the determinant of the coordinate matrix to the determinant of the acting matrix times that determinant.
The left-multiplication polynomial algebra homomorphism preserves membership in the ideal generated by the determinant of the coordinate matrix.
The polynomial algebra homomorphism associated with a product of matrices is the composition of the associated homomorphisms.
The polynomial algebra homomorphism associated with the identity matrix is the identity.
Applying the left-multiplication polynomial algebra homomorphism entrywise to the coordinate matrix yields the transpose coefficient matrix times that coordinate matrix.
The representation of the general linear group on a multivariable polynomial ring induced by left multiplication of square matrices.
The action of an invertible matrix in the representation is the algebra homomorphism associated with its underlying matrix.
An invertible matrix acts on a coordinate variable by the corresponding matrix-linear combination of coordinate variables.
Each algebra homomorphism from the left-multiplication representation commutes with an auxiliary represented algebra homomorphism.
